messages:
Sam: Customer reports tool_call failing with 400 when passing args to the pdf_tool. They pasted payload that fails JSON parse.
Sam: Payload they sent:
```json
{"path": "C:\\Users\\admin\\reports\weekly.csv, "mode": "read",}
```
Sam: Looks like unclosed quote on path and trailing comma. Server responds with: `400 - malformed_tool_args` and parser error `Unexpected token , in JSON at position 45`.
Amelia: Can you confirm client SDK / cURL? Any sanitization? :eyes:
Sam: Using our JS SDK v1.3.4 via node, but customer says they pasted JSON into our web console and also via curl. Repro steps below.
Sam: cURL repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"tool":"pdf_tool","args": {"path": "C:\\temp\\report.csv, "format":"A4",}}'
```
Ryan: That cURL body is invalid JSON because of the unescaped backslashes and missing quote. But if pasted into a shell single-quoted string it should work — however their example shows mismatched quotes inside the single quotes. Could be user paste error or our console sanitization mis-handling backslashes.
Ryan: I also see a pattern: SDK had a bug where it tries to normalize Windows paths and strips the ending quote when doing simple replace. Opening an issue @eng-runtime. :construction:
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-194. Assigned to @Ryan.
Amelia: Prioritize - customer blocked in production. We'll offer a workaround: instruct them to escape backslashes and remove trailing comma. I'll draft message with corrected examples.
Sam: Proposed reply to customer:
```text
Thanks — this is due to malformed JSON in the `args` field. Example working payload:
{"tool":"pdf_tool","args":{"path":"C:\\temp\\report.csv","format":"A4"}}
```
Sam: I'm going to send the snippet and ask if they used the SDK or copy-paste from Windows Explorer. Also asking for their full request_id from logs (<request_id>) to correlate.
Ryan: I'll investigate SDK path normalization tonight. If it's a console auto-formatter bug, DevEx should be looped in @Amelia.
Amelia: Will follow up and notify PM if broader customer impact. Setting priority: high. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks, closing loop for support case but leaving thread open until eng confirms root cause.
